A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
RSPH1 is a novel PCD gene and that loss of radial spoke head proteins causes a distinctive ciliary ultrastructural defect, with a common mechanism for CP agenesis.
RSPH1 is an essential gene in humans and that loss-of-function mutations result in a common mechanism for PCD with CP agenesis.
mutations in RspH1 cause a common mechanism of central pair agenasis in PCD, and that RspH1, RspH4 and RspH9 are likely to be components of the spoke head structure in human cilia.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NGS can be used as a powerful diagnostic tool for PCD and that mutations in RPSH1 can cause PCD with isolated CP loss and normal laterality.
